name: Aggregate Constraint Framing
description: I reframed the local constraint (no two adjacent nodes share a category) as a global aggregate condition (a "conflict score" over the entire sequence must be exactly 0). I also removed the explicit warning about worst-case tests. This forces models to derive the necessity of early pruning themselves; models that translate the aggregate condition literally into a check at the leaves of their search tree will fail due to Time Limit Exceeded on the worst-case tests.
